artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: MODIFIED: `detect_language`'s ascii-majority branch (was `ascii_share > 0.5` -> unconditional "en") now runs a stopword test over the lower-cased ascii word tokens of the sample against nine module-constant stopword sets (`_STOPWORDS`: en/de/fr/it/es/nl/pt/sv/da, `_STOPWORD_LANGS`, `_MIN_STOPWORD_HITS`, `_STOPWORD_TOKEN_RE`); the language with the most hits wins, "en" wins ties (first in `_STOPWORD_LANGS` order), and "en" is the fallback when no language reaches `_MIN_STOPWORD_HITS` (a stated known limit for a language outside the table). The returned dict gains `"stopword_hits"`. The kana/cjk/hangul branches, the letter-share computation, and the four callers are unchanged. Library code, no deploy target of its own.

MODIFIED, ONE-LINE-EQUIVALENT: `_first_differing_outcome_field`'s length branch (previously `"battery.attempts length: %d -> %d" % (len(old_fields), len(new_fields))`, the flattened outcome-field pair counts) now reads `len((existing.get("battery") or {}).get("attempts") or [])` against the same for `new` and reports those attempts counts under the same label (CTO round-27 analysis, msg 24239, `ledger/ROUND_ANALYSIS.round27.md` @0a57690e2e -- C-S386, graduated). Nothing else in the function changed. Library code, no deploy target of its own.
